column4: dialect-gated: this job (go test ./engine/... with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set) runs Postgres and skips MySQL and MSSQL -- cleat#1986's TestWorkflowDefDefaultsToTheAuthExposureClass iterates registeredBackends, so its mysql and mssql subtests both skip here while postgres runs. Same registeredBackends shape as other cluster-job entries in this directory. Measured by NAME on run 36850650072, job 110331216429 (cleat#1986 PR #2888, 2026-10-01): `grep '"Action":"skip"' test-report.json | grep -o '"Test":"[^"]*"' | grep -c 'WorkflowDefDefaultsToTheAuthExposureClass'` = 2, matching the job's reported overage of 617 against a 615 inherited allowance exactly.

Pairing line for the cluster entry above, required by scripts/check-skip-ledger-engine-coverage.py (cleat#2158): engine-race.yml -- the only job that checks the test-go/engine key, 4-hourly off the per-PR trigger set -- runs with the same single-DSN (postgres-only) shape as the cluster job above, so TestWorkflowDefDefaultsToTheAuthExposureClass's mysql and mssql subtests skip there too. Identical regex to the cluster line, as the pairing check requires; not independently measured against a live engine-race.yml run (it is not a per-PR job), but the dialect gating is the same registeredBackends mechanism as the cluster line, which was measured.
